propositions: Establish immutable, serializable OperationSnapshot containing validated non-secret effective configuration values with explicit provenance source-kind tracking and repository root selection, excluding live auth objects, secrets, clients, and subprocess environments.

Implement central composition with explicit precedence: operation input > environment > project config > user config > schema default, where repository root selection follows: explicit repo_root > REBAR_ROOT > Git top-level/current directory.

Thread snapshot through CLI, public library operations, MCP reads/writes/LLM tools, and direct reconciler entry point in shadow mode without altering execution behavior or stored ticket/bridge formats.

Enable REBAR_OPERATION_SNAPSHOT_SHADOW by default to run shadow composition alongside authoritative operations; any snapshot assembly/fingerprint/diagnostic failure is caught and logged without affecting legacy behavior; canonical false disables shadow mode entirely.

Reject malformed selected operation config with typed config error before lock/network/write effects; secret sentinels must be absent from snapshot fields, serialization, fingerprint, repr, equality/hash, provenance, logs, schemas, and exceptions.
